detail.longDescription: I'm the creator of Django Control Room, an open-source framework for building operational tools inside Django Admin. I've released agent skills to help coding agents build project-specific tools: customer support consoles, billing operations, approval queues, and similar workflows. My aim to make it easier to build software products using Django by reducing the number of external services one has to manage. DCR lets you build tools in an already protected surface you likely already host - the Django admin. You can build your own tools or download many existing published tools available in the DCR registry at: https://djangocontrolroom.com/panels/
